newsitem.title: USA: Wash Mutual registration declared effective.
newsitem.headline: Wash Mutual registration declared effective.

text.p: Washington Mutual Inc and Great Western Financial Corp said the Securities and Exchange Commission declared the registration statement relating to their merger as effective.

Earlier, Great Western said it set June 13 for a special meeting of stockholders to vote on the proposed merger with Washington Mutual, which will also hold a meeting that day for its stockholders to vote on the deal.

Great Western announced the merger agreement with Washington Mutual early March in an effort to thwart hostile bidder H.F. Ahmanson and Co. Ahmanson Tuesday asked a judge for an injunction to block Great Western shareholders from voting on the Washington Mutual merger on June 13. It is seeking a court order requiring at least six weeks between the June 13 meeting to determine the directors of Great Western and any vote on the merger.
